overview_description.description:
Ekar is a convenient and flexible pay-as-you-drive hourly and daily car rental service. With Ekar, users can search, book, and unlock cars safely and securely for personal driving use, through a smartphone app and installed technology in rental cars.

Ekar was founded on 2016 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
